error.card_decided: Card {{card}} is not waiting for that decision. It takes: {{decisions}}.
error.card_delivery: Delivery cards are decided with specrails_deliveries.
error.card_unknown: No card {{card}} in this mission. Read the mission's cards for their ids.
error.card_unreadable: Card {{card}} cannot be read, so it cannot be decided.
error.file_too_large: The file is larger than {{max}} MB.
error.no_delivery: {{ref}} has no delivery to return or relaunch.
error.no_limit: This mission is not stopped at a usage limit; pass options.at.
error.no_messages: This mission has no messages yet.
error.no_pin: {{mission}} is not pinned to a project; pin it first (update with options.pin).
error.nothing_to_update: Nothing to update: pass title, provider, model, effort or an option.
error.rail_required: Pass options.rail (a rail index or rail ref).
error.self: A mission cannot message, stop or question its own conversation.
hold.intent_needs_review: The Intent's worktree is gone; close it to keep the branch and spec.
hold.limit_scheduled: Stopped at the provider's usage limit; it continues by itself at {{at}}.
preview.ask: Asks a side question about “{{title}}”; nothing is written to the mission.
preview.card_flow_offer: Starts an Intent session in {{mission}}: an isolated worktree and agent session.
preview.card_pr_ci_offer: Starts a run that watches the pull request's CI and fixes failures.
preview.card_reply: Replies {{decision}} in {{mission}}; the agent starts a turn.
preview.chat_delete: Deletes the chat “{{title}}” and its messages.
preview.hand_off_new_rail: No rail is free: a new rail is created for it.
preview.intent_discard: Discards {{ref}}: its worktree and branch {{branch}} are removed.
preview.intent_hand_off: Hands {{ref}} (branch {{branch}}) to a rail that derives the spec and delivers.
preview.intent_relaunch: Relaunches the Intent → Spec run of {{ref}} on the same worktree.
preview.intent_resume: Resumes {{ref}} and reopens its agent session.
preview.intent_start: Starts an Intent session in {{project}}: an isolated worktree and agent session.
preview.limit_continue: The mission continues by itself at {{at}}.
preview.purge: Deletes the mission “{{title}}” permanently, with its history and attachments.
preview.renew: Writes a summary of “{{title}}” and starts a new provider session from it.
preview.send: Sends the message to “{{title}}”; the agent starts a turn.
reply.implement: Let's write the spec first and run Implement.
reply.implement_existing: Let's implement spec #{{id}} on a rail.
summary.attached: Attached {{name}} to {{mission}}; send it with options.attachmentIds.
summary.card_launched: Launched {{specs}}: {{count}} run(s) started. Follow them with specrails_wait.
summary.created: Created {{mission}}. Send it a message next.
summary.deleted: Moved {{mission}} to the trash; restore undoes it.
summary.get_running: “{{title}}” is working on a turn: {{count}} message(s), {{cards}} card(s) waiting.
summary.intent_closed: Closed {{ref}}; the branch and spec stay.
summary.intent_cost: The Intent cost {{usd}} USD over {{turns}} billed turn(s).
summary.intent_handed_off: Handed {{ref}} to a rail; follow the run with specrails_wait.
summary.intent_returned: {{ref}} is back in Intent with the review.
summary.intent_started: Started {{ref}} ({{state}}). Talk to it with send.
summary.limit_scheduled: The mission continues by itself at {{at}}.
summary.queue_steered: The queued message went into the running turn of {{mission}}.
summary.queued: Queued in {{mission}}; it is read after the running turn. Wait with specrails_wait(until, refs:[{{mission}}]).
summary.renewed: Wrote the summary; the next turn of {{mission}} starts a fresh session.
summary.working: {{mission}} is still working. Wait with specrails_wait(until, refs:[{{mission}}]), then get with options.after.
choice.abort: The agent stops answering; the mission stays.
choice.ci_start: An agent follows CI and fixes failures (AI work).
choice.flow_implement: The agent implements it in this mission.
choice.flow_intent: Opens an Intent session to shape it first.
choice.intent_close: Ends the session; the branch and spec stay.
choice.intent_discard: Throws the session and its branch away.
choice.intent_hand_off: A rail builds and delivers it (AI work).
choice.intent_interrupt: Stops the current turn and sends your message.
choice.intent_pause: The session holds until you resume it.
choice.intent_relaunch: Starts the handed-off run again (AI work).
choice.intent_resume: The session continues where it paused.
choice.intent_return: The work returns to the Intent session.
choice.limit_cancel: The mission will not continue by itself.
choice.limit_continue: The mission resumes at the reset (AI work).
choice.option: Sends this reply; the agent answers in a new turn.
choice.queue: Sends your message after the current turn.
choice.rail_launch: Starts the runs the card proposes (AI work).
choice.reading_alternative: The agent goes on with the other reading.
choice.reading_delegate: The agent decides the rest on its own.
choice.reading_explore: Opens an Intent session from this reading.
choice.reading_restated: The agent goes on as it restated it.
choice.review_delivery: Opens the delivery for your decision.
choice.send: Sends your message; the agent answers (AI work).
choice.unarchive: The mission comes back to the list.
